name: Madai
overview: Madai is a male figure identified in Scripture as a son of Japheth. Beyond this genealogical note, there are no additional details or tribal affiliations provided about him. His mention is concise, focusing primarily on his lineage.
namesAndTitles: The name Madai appears as a proper name in Genesis 10:2. No specific meaning or divine origin of the name is indicated in the biblical text.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Madai as a son of Japheth, placing him within the genealogical framework of Noah's descendants. No other family relationships are documented beyond this paternal connection.
scriptureSignificance: Madai's significance lies chiefly in his role as a descendant of Japheth, contributing to the biblical account of the nations' origins after the Flood. His mention in Genesis 10:2 situates him within the unfolding narrative of God's providential plan to populate the earth. Though brief, his inclusion underscores the comprehensive nature of Scripture's genealogies.
